short_description: Send a heart or a short message from your BUSY Bar to a friend's.
description:
Pair two BUSY Bars and send each other little messages.

## How to use

- On both bars, set the same secret word in the app's settings, and your name.
- Turn the wheel to pick a message: HEART, KISS, CALL ME, HOME, MISS YOU or WAVE.
- Press **Start** to send it.

## What you see

- The other bar shows the message in pink, with the sender's name under it, for 10 seconds.
- Its back display keeps who sent the last message and when.

The BUSY Bar runs one app at a time, so messages arrive only while this app is open. The bar checks for new ones every 10 seconds.

## Privacy

Messages go through the public server [ntfy.sh](https://ntfy.sh), on a channel named after your secret word. Anyone who knows the word can read and send messages, so pick one that is hard to guess. See ntfy.sh's [privacy policy](https://docs.ntfy.sh/privacy/).
changelog: First release: six messages, pairing by a secret word, the last sender on the back display.
